CACE template: power-down states: supply currents, pad leakage, internal enable
sg13cmos5l_IOPadSingle2Diff: outp - outn = 2 (pad - vref), CM = vcm. Sources and analysis are in the code blocks.
xc (en_ctrl_3v3) and xg (bias_gen_pd): outside the pad cell since 2026-11-04 (backannotation to the drawn cell),
wired as in the former pad sheet; the sources that drove the old pad pins now drive them.
